remarks: Welcome to this beautifully 2 bedroom + OFFICE situated ground-level end unit overlooking the golf course in the desirable Rancho San Joaquin community. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with a versatile office offers an open and comfortable layout, abundant natural light, and peaceful golf-course views. The kitchen with a dining area opens directly to the living room, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. Step outside from the living room onto your patio and enjoy beautiful golf-course views, with a peaceful pond and birds swimming right outside your home.
